brief:
An Israeli drone strike north of Khan Younis wounded at least six Palestinians, the Wafa news agency reported. According to the agency, two missiles struck a tent located near the Albanian mosque in the area.

The strike added to the toll of casualties in Gaza's southern region, where Khan Younis has faced repeated Israeli military operations. The report did not specify the conditions of those wounded or provide additional details about damage to surrounding structures near the mosque.
